mechanism_claims.claim_text: mKLK shows source-supported antibiofilm phenotypes: inhibition of initial adhesion, inhibition of biofilm formation, dispersal of pre-formed biofilm, MBEC reduction versus KLK, and in vivo catheter-biofilm reduction.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a phenotypic antibiofilm finding, not a molecular mechanism such as direct membrane permeabilization.
